description: 【和歌山県】和歌山県内の道路規制情報 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 一般国道及び県道の和歌山県管理区間及び市町村管理道路において行われる道路規制情報を、地理情報システムを用いて提供しています。 ・市町村管理道路については、市町村より報告のあった箇所を掲載しています。 詳細は管理する各市町村にお問い合わせください。. Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. Its tags are マップ, マップ情報, 地図, 地図情報, 地理. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv, geojson, html, kml, zip. The portal shows 2022-10-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
